hypothesis: A deterministic provenance-bound dataset manifest can make known TRAIN/DEV -> HELDOUT leakage fail closed while remaining completely separate from model-training authority.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Explicit family identity can be incomplete, incorrect or adversarially supplied; therefore this candidate cannot prove semantic non-contamination and requires independent family/near-duplicate evidence plus dynamic/OOD and sealed final evaluation before promotion.

semantic_rules: raw and conservative normalized content hashes are domain-bound into deterministic split/manifest roots
source snapshot, family evidence, label identity and cutoff metadata are carried
cross-split exact and normalized duplicates fail closed
HELDOUT sharing an explicitly evidenced family with TRAIN or DEV fails closed
family identity/evidence remains evidence, not semantic truth
candidate exposes no training action surface

go_out_of_box.intervention: TRAIN and HELDOUT paraphrases with different byte/normalized hashes but one explicitly evidenced semantic family
go_out_of_box.claim_boundary: Demonstrates a falsifier for exact-only decontamination; does not establish correctness of the family relation or global semantic contamination freedom.
